prompt: what makes countries go to war
judge_reasoning: Response [1] directly answers the prompt by listing multiple factors that can drive countries toward war (e.g., territorial disputes, resource competition, security concerns) with relevant historical examples. Responses [2], [3], and [4] shift to different questions—economic impacts of war, preparation/deterrence strategies, and peacekeeping/peace promotion strategies—so they do not explain what causes countries to go to war. Overall relevance and coverage are clearly strongest for [1], with the others largely off-target.
